title: The Rotting World
description: An infection mod adding a rotting, ancient disease.
body:
The Rotting World (TRW) is a (somewhat) unique infection mod, it comes into your world as a form of a craftable block, a bio-weapon.
If left uncontrolled for too long, it begins destroying your world.

DETAILS:
The infection starts in a form of a single "Dehydrated Dirt" block (craftable.)
Unless the "Liquid Life" item is used as a barrier around it, it will continue spreading, ammasing points.
At some point when it has gathered enough points, it will start naturally spawning its mobs everywhere.

_It is somewhat unfair, as it is my first infection-styled mod._
